/_sources.input.tieTolerancePt: DECISION: the L52a midpoint tie band = min(tieTolerancePt / zoom, tieTolerancePitch x pitch): a release that close to the boundary between two different arrows' cells counts as their midpoint (the right-hand, then the lower arrow wins) so touch quantisation (XCUITest rounds to whole points) cannot flip it; 3 % of a cell never reaches an in-cell tap (0 of 873 + 399 jittered points change owner), while a flat 1 pt stole 41 of 873 on a 9.4 pt board
/_sources.intro: motion §6.1 pass 2 (S1-L48-play-intro 60 Hz): zoom 1.49 -> 1 easeOutCubic 1.35 s; draw 0.32 s + 21.6 ms/cell
/_sources.key.diveGPitch: B2 reconciliation (report): SPEC-motion-audio §3.5.2 row 4 measured a 0.224 s dive over 160 pt at pitch 17.86 (8.96 cells) and the burst at tap + 1.14 s, but its formula constant 428 p/s2 (= 7650 pt/s2 / 17.86) gives sqrt(2 x 8.96 / 428) = 0.205 s for that same dive (burst 1.12 s). The measured beat wins: g = 2 x 8.96 / 0.224^2 = 357 p/s2 reproduces the 0.224 s dive and the 1.14 s burst (L33's first key, D 9.42 cells: burst 1.14 s).

App/Resources/Tuning/social.json./_doc: SOC1 + SOC1b (SPEC-social §7, §12-§14; PathCore/Social/SocialConfig.swift). Event tunables of the offline world; the population constants are code (SocialModel.swift), only the model name is data. Shared with C3: 'unlocks' (EventID raw values) and 'events' (C3's layout, compiled defaults while absent). SocialNamesTests keeps this file equal to the compiled defaults. SOC1b = the recalibration to phone session 2 (research/social-dynamics.md; build/soc1b/calibration.md). SOC1c = drawn nicknames (duplicates allowed) + Sky Jump stage 3 = 10 levels (build/soc1c/calibration.md).
App/Resources/Tuning/social.json./events/_doc: C3's layout (Events/EventSchedule.swift EventRules; EconomyRules.load reads this block) and SOC's (SocialConfig reads the same keys): ONE source for both. SOC1c: Sky Jump stage 3 = 10 levels, PRIZE 10000 (phone sessions 2 and 3: 'Pass 10 Levels in a row on first try', 100 100 91 83 75 66 57 48 40 32 -> 7 winners, 10000/7 = 1428). C3's other event values keep their compiled defaults.
App/Resources/Tuning/social.json./matchmaking/streak/_doc: phone v552 + session 2: a 50-row ranking that starts with every rival at 0 when the player joins (arriveAtJoin), listed alphabetically at equal scores (tieByName); members = players who win a level within matchWindowMinutes [before, after] the join (sameHours bands) + 8 idle ones; r = the member's levels per PLAYED day / the player's wins per active day (floored at minTarget). failQ = [lo, span]: a member's fail chance before each win = lo + span x u01 (the phone's leaders ran long unbroken x100 streaks).
App/Resources/Tuning/social.json./matchmaking/weekly/_doc: phone v552: a 10-player group, complete when the player joins (members arrived within 15 min before) and online (sameHours = playing within matchWindowMinutes [before, after] the join; SOC1b: the idle band too — the phone's two idle rivals scored in the first 85 min, then nothing all day). bands = [count, r_lo, r_hi, sameHours] with r = the member's expected weekly levels / the player's reference.
App/Resources/Tuning/social.json./rocketBots/_doc: SOC1: hold = minutes a finishing rival waits at N-1 after the join, delta = x the player's seconds per win after the player's N-1. SOC1b (phone: one rival finishes 5 levels 6-19 min after the join): roles of the four lanes (sprint = beats N levels within sprintMinutes x N/5 at its own pace; hot >= 2 levels in 20 min; steady 1-3) and hold minutes per role.
App/Resources/Tuning/social.json./skyBots/_doc: SOC1b (phone session 2 §F) + SOC1c (session 3 §I-E): Sky Jump players left after each first-try win, per stage [drop lo, drop hi, first step, winners lo, winners hi]: a per-run drop d in [lo, hi] (each step d +- 1) from the player's step `first`; the winners share the pool (stage 2: 100 100 88 75 62 49 36 -> 15 winners, 7000/15 = 466; stage 3, 10 levels: 100 100 91 83 75 66 57 48 40 32 -> 7 winners, 10000/7 = 1428).
